description: 黑后弃子引入，黑车透视底线将死
explanation_en: Black sacrifices the queen with check to force White's rook away from the first rank, allowing the rook on a1 to deliver back-rank mate through the cleared line.

intro.popup: 💡 透视攻击：黑后在a6，黑车在a1，白车在e1，白王在h1。黑方如何弃后完成透视将死？
intro.popup_en: 💡 X-ray attack: Black's queen is on a6, rook on a1, White's rook on e1, and king on h1. How can Black sacrifice the queen to create an X-ray back-rank mate?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qf1+引入——白车离开e1吃后，黑车a1透视穿越e1直取f1将死！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qf1+ forces White's rook away from e1 to capture the queen. Black's rook on a1 then attacks through the cleared first rank and mates on f1.

moves.popup: 黑后弃子Qf1+！后沿第1横线将军白王h1，强制白车从e1出来应对，为黑车透视攻击清路。
moves.popup_en: Black sacrifices the queen with Qf1+, checking the king on h1 and forcing White's rook away from e1, clearing the first rank for Black's rook.

moves.popup: 白车被迫吃后，从e1移至f1，第1横线通道打开！
moves.popup_en: White's rook is forced to capture the queen, moving from e1 to f1 and opening the first rank.

moves.popup: 透视攻击将死！黑车a1早已透视白车e1盯住f1，白车移走后黑车直取f1将死白王！
moves.popup_en: X-ray checkmate! Black's rook on a1 was targeting f1 through White's rook on e1. Once it moves, Rxf1# mates the king.
